judgment.rationale: The app names and intended arrangement are known, but the saved z-order contract and final arrival sequence need verification.
evidence: A 0.86 Workspaces report says Spotify starts more slowly than Chrome and disrupts the desired background/foreground ordering with IntelliJ and Chrome.
The report describes a desired layout but does not establish the order of every launched window or current behavior.

The current launcher iterates waiting apps and limits waits for instances of the same application; a bounded wait does not by itself establish preserved z-order: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/Workspaces/WorkspacesLauncher/Launcher.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The app names and intended arrangement are known, but the saved z-order contract and final arrival sequence need verification.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate workspace launch z-order
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Asynchronous launch and window arrival may change foreground order after placement, but a general launch delay is not proven to solve it.
plan: Reproduce the three-application workspace with differing startup times and record actual window arrival and z-order after all windows settle.
Check whether saved workspace data captures the requested foreground order and where the arranger applies it.
If the data and product contract support it, restore z-order after identified windows are placed without arbitrarily blocking launch or stealing focus indefinitely.
verification: After all three windows settle, their saved layout and intended foreground order are restored without indefinitely delaying slower applications.

reproduce.title: Launch the reported three-app workspace
prerequisites: Spotify, IntelliJ IDEA and Chrome installed
setup: Save a workspace with Spotify behind IntelliJ and Chrome, the latter two arranged side by side.
steps: Launch the workspace and wait until all windows finish opening.
Compare final positions and foreground order with the saved arrangement.
